warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_mm) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_mm). Opening sizes are written in integer mm (section 0.5) with the printed metres kept in *_printed_as. Heights are measured from ระดับพื้นห้อง; door and window heads are 2.05, น3's head is 2.15.
น1's sill (0.85) and window height (1.20) sit on the page's left edge and were read from a zoomed crop; they match น2 (0.85 + 1.20 = 2.05).
